page_title: ATA 2-0 CAG | Atalanta v Cagliari 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+3' Michel Adopo (Atalanta) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The total number of attempts is 11:11.
88' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
86' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) plays a lovely through ball to Luis Muriel, but he can't beat Boris Radunovic and loses the ball.
85' Atalanta fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
84' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul.
83' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
80' Substitution. Davide Zappacosta makes way for Michel Adopo (Atalanta).
80' Substitution. Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) in, Matteo Ruggeri out.
80' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gets inside the box and tries to beat Boris Radunovic with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
78' It will be a substitution. Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) is ready to enter the pitch as Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi walks off.
78' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) replaces Eldor Shomurodov.
77' Close! Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
76' 2 - 0 Goal! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
74' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
72' Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) commits a foul and Ermano Feliciani immediately signals a free kick.
70' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) will deliver the corner kick.
67' Substitution. Ademola Lookman walks off the pitch and Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.
67' Here is a change. Charles De Ketelaere is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Emil Holm (Atalanta).
65' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
64' Substitution. Ibrahim Sulemana leaves the pitch and is replaced by Benito Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
64' The referee signals a substitution. Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Pantelis Chatzidiakos.
64' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
62' Atalanta quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Ederson and he is replaced by Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
59' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
57' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
54' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
52' A corner kick by Cagliari is thwarted by the well prepared Juan Musso (Atalanta).
52' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Now Cagliari have a corner.
51' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
49' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
48' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a half-time substitution. Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) comes on in place of Alessandro Deiola.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' It's a throw-in for Cagliari.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) sends a long ball in, but Juan Musso comfortably gathers the ball.
42' The referee is firm and issues Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) a deserved yellow card.
39' Cagliari take a short corner kick.
38' None of the Cagliari players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
37' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Boris Radunovic stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
37' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared.

37' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
35' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) scores after an assist by Charles De Ketelaere that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:0.
32' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
31' A snap shot by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Boris Radunovic produces a good save to thwart him.
29' One of the players from Atalanta times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
27' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
26' Crossbar! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
25' Good movement by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
24' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Atalanta due to an offside in the build-up play.
24' The Atalanta players joy may have been justified, because referee Ermano Feliciani is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
23' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
23' The foul by Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) was seen by Ermano Feliciani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
20' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
18' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Boris Radunovic punches the ball away.
16' Atalanta work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
16' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.
16' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
15' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly wide of the left post.
14' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post.
13' Atalanta fail to score from a corner as Boris Radunovic (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.
13' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
13' Atalanta take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

12' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) unleashes a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Boris Radunovic thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
11' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
10' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) commits a foul during an attacking move.
9' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Ermano Feliciani interrupts the game. One of the players from Cagliari won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
5' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' Atalanta are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) was too forceful with his tackle and Ermano Feliciani interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Ermano Feliciani.
